p.s: Is shopping not always enjoyable, is it?
We can't say that is always enjoyable or is not.
Every new day is not the same.
But...
I think that good shopping depends on ourself.
If we decided to by somthing special and we have enough money for it we have to go and buy it.
Probably, maybe not.
Some times we have to have deal with not good service or for example could you imagine it on your way to shop you have met wrong people or someone told you bad news.
Or quality of your new thing is not so good that you really expected.
Situations are variously.
Maybe you will spend all your money for a new thing and a few hours later your best friend will invite you to go to night-club but you are short of money.
Some people will do crazy things in situation like this.
They will hate this new thing because they will miss a party.
But I want to wish you have a good enjoyable shopping all your way.
